newsitem.title: USA: Asia Pulp buys 64 percent of Nippecraft.
newsitem.headline: Asia Pulp buys 64 percent of Nippecraft.

text.p: Asia Pulp & Paper Co. Ltd. said Wednesday its APP Printing (Holding) Pte. Ltd. subsidiary has a definitive agreement to acquire a 64 percent stake in Nippecraft Ltd. for about $32 million.
The stake is being sold by Nippecraft's controlling shareholder, whom an Asia Pulp company spokeswoman in New York declined to identify.
Nippecraft is a Singapore-based company that produces stationery and related products.
Asia Pulp said APP is required under Singapore law to make a general offer for the remaining shares of Nippecraft at the same price per share as that paid to Nippecraft's controlling shareholder.
In addition, APP has agreed to subscribe, for $6.4 million, to a proposed rights offering by Nippecraft.
Asia Pulp's stock was unchanged at $11.625 on the New York Stock Exchange in late morning trading.
